description: 園管局科技產業園區土地租金暨公共設施建設費用 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部產業園區管理局. 1. 提供各園區土地租金暨公共設施建設費等資訊。 2. 收集此資料之目的：管理園區土地使用。 3. 收集此資料之方式：於每二年公告地價調整或公共設施投入時取得。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部產業園區管理局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
